title: Cloud Functions YAML configuration
description: Configuration file of the terraform-google-cloud-functions-yaml module.

project_id.description: Default project for every function in this file. Takes precedence over the module's project_id variable; a function-level project_id takes precedence over this.

functions.description: Cloud Run functions keyed by logical key (the default function name).

template_placeholder.description: A ${...} placeholder, replaced when the module renders the file with templatefile().

labels.description: Key/value labels. Numbers and booleans are converted to strings.

env_vars.description: Environment variables. Numbers and booleans are converted to strings.

deletion_policy.description: Provider-level deletion policy. PREVENT makes terraform destroy fail; ABANDON removes the function from state without deleting it.

member.description: IAM member: user:, group:, serviceAccount:, domain:, principal://, principalSet://, allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.

iam_binding.description: Grants one IAM role to one or more members (non-authoritative, one google_cloudfunctions2_function_iam_member per member).

members.description: Members to grant the role to.

defaults.description: Values applied to every function unless the function sets its own. See docs/configuration.md for the merge rules.

region.description: Default region of every function, e.g. europe-west1. Takes precedence over the module's region variable.

labels.description: Labels added to every function. Function labels with the same key take precedence.

functions.description: Default function settings, merged underneath every function (mappings merge up to three levels deep; lists and other values are replaced).

function.description: A Cloud Run function (Cloud Functions 2nd gen).

enabled.description: Set to false to skip this function (default true). Handy with template variables per environment.

name.description: Function name (default: the key). Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; starts with a letter; at most 63 characters.

project_id.description: Project of this function. Takes precedence over the top-level project_id.

region.description: Region of this function. Takes precedence over defaults.region.

labels.description: Labels, merged over defaults.labels and defaults.functions.labels.

kms_key_name.description: Cloud KMS key that encrypts the function (projects/P/locations/L/keyRings/R/cryptoKeys/K).

invokers.description: Members allowed to call the function (roles/run.invoker on its Cloud Run service). allUsers makes an HTTP function public.

iam.description: Additional IAM grants on the function.

runtime.description: Runtime ID, e.g. python312, nodejs22, go123, java21, ruby33, php83, dotnet8.

entry_point.description: Name of the function in the source code that is executed.

docker_repository.description: Artifact Registry repository for the function image (projects/P/locations/L/repositories/R).

service_account.description: Service account that runs the build (projects/P/serviceAccounts/EMAIL).

runtime_update_policy.description: Base image security updates: AUTOMATIC (applied continuously) or ON_DEPLOY (applied when the function is deployed).

source.description: Where the source code comes from. Set exactly one of dir, zip, object and repo.

dir.description: Local directory (relative to the configuration file) that is zipped and uploaded to bucket.

zip.description: Local .zip file (relative to the configuration file) that is uploaded to bucket.

excludes.description: Glob patterns of files in dir to leave out of the archive.

bucket.description: Cloud Storage bucket for uploads (dir, zip) or holding the existing object. Name only, without gs://.

object_prefix.description: Prefix for uploaded object names, e.g. functions/.

object.description: Existing object in bucket that holds the zipped source.

generation.description: Generation of object to deploy (default: latest).

repo_source.description: Cloud Source Repositories source. Set one of branch_name, tag_name and commit_sha.

project_id.description: Project of the repository (default: the function's project).

dir.description: Directory in the repository that holds the source.

available_cpu.description: CPUs per instance, e.g. "1", "2", "0.583" (default: derived from memory).

timeout_seconds.description: Request timeout in seconds (HTTP functions up to 3600, event-driven functions up to 540).

max_instance_request_concurrency.description: Concurrent requests per instance (needs at least 1 CPU when above 1).

ingress_settings.description: Which traffic may reach the function.

all_traffic_on_latest_revision.description: Route all traffic to the latest revision (default true).

service_account_email.description: Runtime service account (default: the Compute Engine default service account).

vpc_connector_egress_settings.description: Which egress goes through the connector.

direct_vpc_egress.description: Which egress goes through Direct VPC.

direct_vpc_network_interface.description: Direct VPC egress network interfaces (instead of a connector).

binary_authorization_policy.description: Binary Authorization policy checked on deployment, e.g. default.

secret_environment_variables.description: Secret Manager secrets exposed as environment variables.

secret_volumes.description: Secret Manager secrets mounted as files.

network.description: VPC network name or self link.

secret_environment_variable.description: A secret exposed as an environment variable.

project_id.description: Project of the secret (default: the function's project).

mount_path.description: Directory the secret is mounted at, e.g. /etc/secrets.

project_id.description: Project of the secret (default: the function's project).

versions.description: Versions to mount and their file names (default: latest, named after the secret).

secret_volume_version.description: A secret version mounted as a file.

event_trigger.description: Makes the function event-driven (Eventarc). Without it the function is an HTTP function.

event_type.description: Event type, e.g. google.cloud.storage.object.v1.finalized (default with pubsub_topic: google.cloud.pubsub.topic.v1.messagePublished).

pubsub_topic.description: Pub/Sub topic: a short name (in the function's project) or projects/P/topics/T.

trigger_region.description: Region of the trigger (default: the function's region). Must match the location of e.g. the bucket for storage events.

service_account_email.description: Service account the trigger uses to invoke the function. Grant it roles/run.invoker via invokers.

event_filters.description: Filters on event attributes, e.g. bucket for storage events.

attribute.description: Attribute name, e.g. bucket, serviceName, methodName, database, document.

value.description: Attribute value (a path pattern with operator match-path-pattern).

operator.description: Set to match-path-pattern for path patterns such as users/{userId}.
